scope: Native source-model liveness diagnostics on the same fixed directional-lane configuration. This is not an aggregation-policy effectiveness comparison or a serial timing benchmark. Raw identities and sampled motion remain local and are excluded.

mechanism.visible_projection: Use the nearest current interval point whenever the exact route-space segment is permitted; clear the occluded-goal cache.
mechanism.occluded_projection: Latch the first occluded projection and reuse it while the current nearest projection remains occluded. This prevents each lateral avoidance movement from resetting the target, detour and progress detector.
mechanism.initial_target: The verified implementation initially latches the occluded projection; it does not substitute the nominal route endpoint.
mechanism.active_detour: Visible projection may resume even while a detour exists. This is the behavior exercised by the accepted private diagnostic.
mechanism.arrival: Every actual center point on the permitted sink interval remains eligible for exit; no teleport, body-radius reduction or collision-check relaxation is introduced.

cause: Recomputing an occluded nearest sink target after every lateral movement repeatedly reset the route detour and no-progress detector. Conversely, globally freezing even visible targets recreated convergence at a common clipped interval endpoint.

rejected_global_latch.termination: Stopped after the 300-second snapshot demonstrated persistent convergence queues; not a complete 900-second run.

occluded_projection_only.aggregate_checkpoint_source: Private harness stderr captured in the tool execution output.

regressions.focused_native_suite: MappedSceneTests passed after the final refinement.
regressions.concave_obstacle: The nearest boundary projection is initially occluded. The source successfully replans around a concave wall, preserves movement constraints and speed bounds, and drains. Restoring the former projection policy fails the successful-detour regression.
regressions.visible_outflow: Two independent visible flows with a shared nominal route endpoint exit at separate interval positions (6 m and 8 m), with zero physical overlap violations.

limitations: The accepted diagnostic records completion by a 210-second aggregate checkpoint rather than the exact final episode time.
The diagnostic uses one seed and one 256-person configuration. The registered native source gate and the separate 500-person run provide additional validation.
Private debug logs contain operational track tokens and positions and are not included in this artifact. Only their hashes and aggregate counts are retained.
